result.keyword: What's the best payroll software for a small business?
result.markdown:
The best payroll software for a small business depends largely on where your business operates, how many employees you have, and whether you need payroll integrated with your accounting software.

If you're operating in Australia, I would shortlist **Xero, MYOB, Employment Hero and QuickBooks** rather than US-focused options such as Gusto or OnPay.

For an Australian small business, the most important features are\:

- ATO Single Touch Payroll (STP) Phase 2 reporting.
- Superannuation calculations and payments.
- PAYG withholding and tax reporting.
- Award rates, penalty rates and overtime.
- Leave accruals and payslips.
- Integration with your accounting software.

## My top recommendations for Australian businesses

![Small business, big stress – and finding the right balance for success](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/js_DP_ZcJt2b0HYevLiH8RyWaqBcysH-7umi2-OpUv1L_c7R6GqF2ePsaUUNhFEx0xoCJM9UhE2ygbfJvKTZATLo4fmY2I8PpXkEP4z5gNTNS9QARFCTPWNcGDYwVCjusvLzfwG5BpY7OHDvJf-Gvvkz7eUnU1rkY8PEcDFGKBEcxvEb1v6GA_F2cLDI9Uk_?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Xero Payroll**

(Best overall for most small businesses)

- Excellent accounting integration.
- STP reporting and super payments.
- Employee payslips, leave and timesheets.
- Best if you already use Xero.
  
  Payroll included in accounting plans; pricing depends on employee limits.
  
  [Xero website](https://www.xero.com/au/)

---

![MYOB - Features, Reviews & Pricing (February 2026)](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/RSnJXDEAckMg49Z3Uyl1ySpGe5Mf5xY-fiHvWrkutyMlRVsk_cizHWnHbb0_8J0spngX92NOecbYb0xtPztOW_1U5_j589rcfR6e_7DzDwZO-F8qM8BNDHiplH9bI1r3qal9-SnHWVHGyS5SP06Y1atDJc1eUMWI1ht7KCGJtRhy8le1UHOPMDyYDZIt-Ehu?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. MYOB**

(Best for very small teams)

- Standalone payroll option for up to four employees.
- Handles PAYG, super and STP.
- Good accounting integration.
  
  Payroll Only approximately \$20/month as at November 2026.
  
  [MYOB website](https://www.myob.com/au)

---

![2025 Employment Hero Annual Jobs Report Reveals a Workforce Under Pressure, On the Move, and Rewriting the Rules](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/c72cfBM-wnkCY2sXvC-N2bdeXlozX_a6cLpeiRcNWIdO5skRSiJsO0H69D4TjL37larxeB9RHeRje9o33vXlesf4SGbT2cKN9yyK2lD71zg8gVLQUlVbvzPmQ7XZL_7bga6vNjcRIhuVAHDdb80aC6efbG65m_LmQQnOM37zl4ReRd-YURSotCy3M4QrvYQn?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Employment Hero**

(Best for award-based employees)

- Australian Modern Award interpretation.
- Rostering and timesheets.
- HR, onboarding and payroll.
- Particularly useful for hospitality, retail and shift workers.
  
  Payroll pricing starts around \$10 per employee/month, with a 10-user minimum.
  
  [Employment Hero website](https://employmenthero.com/au/)

---

![Reckon Payroll 2026 Pricing, Features, Reviews & Alternatives | GetApp](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/ACef1V9QbM8Y3LxjLzJIQV-TfChUBjwyyx7W6AOhVMywuWusbhYulcZYBn3S8A-J1ZSIIaQtu8WMi3CVnQm3fE7mKMbBw3Beo_sQTtWxx5CDDP34nqzqL6m70W1jmud24Hdj0BDI4_JPvo8A-h8b5n6w-92zDw-PxjtUuoZZ2u15XApkZg7xxx4sYiZVnXkz?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Reckon**

(Best budget option)

- Affordable payroll for small teams.
- STP reporting and super.
- Useful standalone option.
  
  Plans from approximately \$16/month for up to four employees.
  
  [Reckon website](https://www.reckon.com/au/)

Pricing and comparisons based on Australian market research available in November 2026. Confirm current plan limits and fees before purchasing. [australiansmallbusiness.com.au](https://australiansmallbusiness.com.au/software/best-payroll-software-australia?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.testnotes.com.au](https://www.testnotes.com.au/best-payroll-software-australia?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.techrepublic.com](https://www.techrepublic.com/article/best-payroll-software-australia/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## Which one would I choose?

My starting recommendation would be\:

- **1–5 employees\:** Xero or MYOB.
- **5–20 employees\:** Xero or Employment Hero.
- **20+ employees\:** Employment Hero or a more comprehensive payroll solution.
- **Hospitality or retail\:** Employment Hero, particularly where award rates and penalty rates matter.

One important consideration: Australia's Payday Super requirements commenced on 1 July 2026, so make sure your chosen system supports paying super in line with the new requirements. search_results.description: The article reviews payroll platforms for small businesses in 2026, assessing features, pricing, usability, integrations, documentation, and customer support. Gusto is its top dependable choice, combining full-service payroll, tax compliance, benefits, and accounting integrations. Xero stands out for accounting and app integrations, while QuickBooks is recommended for mobile payroll. Paychex suits businesses seeking outsourced HR and benefits administration; Rippling offers flexible, scalable HR, payroll, IT, and expense tools. Remote Payroll supports international hiring and compliance, and Zoho People bundles payroll with a broad HR and business ecosystem. Other picks include PeopleHR for UK SMEs, Patriot Payroll for straightforward value, BambooHR for ease of use, Hourly for time tracking and workers’ compensation, 1st Money for small UK businesses (free for fewer than 10 employees), Breathe HR for simplified HR, and Employment Hero for advanced features. The article also highlights ADP’s payroll and HR services. It advises choosing software based on business size and required features, prioritizing compliance, integrations, transparent pricing, employee self-service, and responsive support.
